name: Pebbleheart Hatchling
rules: Crack — Deal 2 damage to an enemy creature.
art_target: Tiny pebble hatchling splitting open, red/blue crystal cores visible; curious low quadruped silhouette, not a humanoid golem.

name: Quartz Bulwark
rules: Cracked — Taunt.
art_target: Massive layered quartz bulwark like a mineral tortoise; broad blue facets interlock into a living defensive wall.

name: Lava Geode
rules: Cracked — The first time Lava Geode attacks each round, deal 1 additional damage to its target after combat.
art_target: Lean volcanic geode predator with fresh magma cracks and red crystal vents, caught mid-lunge as heat spills from within.

name: Lumen Nodule
rules: Crack — Restore 3 HP divided among friendly creatures.
art_target: Gentle glowing crystal nodule with blue-green capillary light, sheltering smaller stones as healing radiance diffuses outward.

name: Razor Geode
rules: Cracked — The first time Razor Geode attacks each round, it gains +2 STR for that combat.
art_target: Razor-thin obsidian geode hunter with red/violet blade fins and a predatory angular stance built around speed and cutting edges.

name: Mirrorstone Egg
rules: Crack — Choose an enemy creature. Mirrorstone Egg gains STR equal to that creature's printed STR this round, maximum +4 STR.
art_target: Uncanny mirrored crystal egg reflecting a distorted enemy silhouette across flawless blue-violet facets; mysterious rather than aggressive.

name: Deepcore Cocoon
rules: Dormant — Taunt. Crack — Restore 2 HP to Deepcore Cocoon.
art_target: Huge deep-earth cocoon armored in blue-green stone plates, half-buried and immovable, with a protected luminous core.

name: Gemscale Larva
rules: Crack — If Gemscale Larva has not acted this round, it immediately gains one additional combat action.
art_target: Iridescent gemscale larva bursting from a green-red shell, body already elongating into a fast crystalline attacker.

name: Stressborn Cluster
rules: The first time each round a Prism is attached to Stressborn Cluster, it gains +2 STR this round. Crack — Draw 1 card.
art_target: Dense unstable cluster of red-violet crystals bowing under internal stress, energy building unevenly through many competing fracture lines.

name: Shard Choir Seed
rules: Cracked — The first three times each round another friendly Geode receives a Prism, Shard Choir Seed gains +1 STR this round.
art_target: Choir-like seed cluster of green-violet crystal spires resonating in harmony, each small shard amplifying the others.

name: Crown Geode
rules: Crack — Draw 2 cards, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Regal crown-shaped geode with cathedral-like blue-violet crystal towers and a guarded luminous chamber at its center.

name: Worldheart Geode
rules: At the end of your round, if Worldheart Geode has at least 2 Prisms attached, restore 2 HP to another friendly Geode.
art_target: Ancient worldstone heart-creature rooted into a cavern floor, vast green-blue crystal arteries feeding nearby geodes.

name: Violet Shard
signature_detail: Red/Blue | Red: Attached Geode gains +2 STR during its first combat action each round. | Blue: Whenever attached Geode is about to take combat damage, it gains Shield 1 before that damage.
rules: PRISM — Choose Red or Blue when attached. Red: Attached Geode gains +2 STR during its first combat action each round. Blue: Whenever attached Geode is about to take combat damage, it gains Shield 1 before that damage.
art_target: Single elegant dual-mode shard suspended in darkness, one face red and aggressive, the other blue and protective.

name: Emberbloom Prism
signature_detail: Red/Green | Red: Attached Geode has +1 STR. | Green: At the start of your round, restore 1 HP to attached Geode.
rules: PRISM — Choose Red or Green when attached. Red: Attached Geode has +1 STR. Green: At the start of your round, restore 1 HP to attached Geode.
art_target: Flowering red-green prism with ember-like petals and living crystal growth, balancing heat and renewal in one artifact.

name: Riftglass Prism
signature_detail: Red/Violet | Red: Attached Geode deals +2 damage on direct attacks. | Violet: The first time each round you attach another Prism, attached Geode gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP this round.
rules: PRISM — Choose Red or Violet when attached. Red: Attached Geode deals +2 damage on direct attacks. Violet: The first time each round you attach another Prism, attached Geode gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP this round.
art_target: Jagged red-violet riftglass prism split by an impossible internal seam, light refracting into sharp duplicated silhouettes.

name: Tidemoss Prism
signature_detail: Blue/Green | Blue: The first damage attached Geode takes each round is reduced by 1. | Green: At the end of your round, restore 2 HP to attached Geode.
rules: PRISM — Choose Blue or Green when attached. Blue: The first damage attached Geode takes each round is reduced by 1. Green: At the end of your round, restore 2 HP to attached Geode.
art_target: Smooth blue-green tidemoss prism partially overgrown with mineral moss, waterlike light moving beneath its surface.

name: Mirror Prism
signature_detail: Blue/Violet | Blue: At the start of Action Phase, attached Geode gains Shield 1. | Violet: For Crack Recipe checks, this Prism may satisfy any one missing color instead of Violet.
rules: PRISM — Choose Blue or Violet when attached. Blue: At the start of Action Phase, attached Geode gains Shield 1. Violet: For Crack Recipe checks, this Prism may satisfy any one missing color instead of Violet.
art_target: Cold blue-violet mirror prism with a polished reflective face and a second impossible reflection bending toward missing colors.

name: Verdant Echo Prism
signature_detail: Green/Violet | Green: When attached Geode Cracks, restore 4 HP to it. | Violet: When attached Geode Cracks, draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
rules: PRISM — Choose Green or Violet when attached. Green: When attached Geode Cracks, restore 4 HP to it. Violet: When attached Geode Cracks, draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Verdant green-violet echo prism with layered translucent growth rings, as if earlier crystal forms are preserved inside it.

name: Refraction Screen
rules: When a friendly Dormant Geode with at least 1 Prism is attacked, it gains Shield 2 before combat.
art_target: Faceted defensive screen snapping into existence around a dormant geode at the instant an attack approaches.

name: Emergency Facet
rules: When a friendly Dormant Geode would be destroyed by damage, if it is exactly one color short of its Crack Recipe, treat one attached Prism as a wild color for that Crack check. If it Cracks, prevent 3 of that damage.
art_target: Emergency crystal facet erupting at a lethal fracture point, one improvised wild-color flare completing the geode at the last second.

name: Seed of the Deep
rules: The first time each round a Prism is attached to Seed of the Deep, restore 1 HP to it. Cracked — At the start of your round, restore 1 additional HP to it.
art_target: Small seed geode nestled in deep stone, green crystal shoots emerging from cracks while the core slowly repairs itself.

name: Faultborn Sentinel
rules: Crack — Gain Shield 2. Cracked — The first damage Faultborn Sentinel takes each round is reduced by 1.
art_target: Stocky sentinel geode with red-blue plated shoulders, shieldlike crystal growths and a freshly cracked luminous defensive core.

name: Crystal Parasite
rules: The first time each round another friendly Geode receives a Prism, Crystal Parasite gains +1 STR this round and restores 1 HP.
art_target: Small violet crystal parasite clinging to a larger geode and feeding on nearby prism light, clever and slightly unsettling.

name: Glassjaw Colossus
rules: Whenever Glassjaw Colossus takes 3 or more damage from one source and survives, it gains +2 STR this round.
art_target: Top-heavy glassjaw colossus built from clear stressed crystal, visibly fragile yet terrifyingly powerful after surviving a heavy strike.

name: Prismatic Broodmother
rules: Crack — Summon a 0/3 Shardling. A Shardling Cracks into 3/3 when any Prism is attached to it.
art_target: Large broodmother geode with a cavernous crystal womb, releasing a tiny 0/3 shardling while multicolor fissures open across her shell.

name: Aurex, Worldheart Unsealed
signature_detail: Crack Recipe: Red + Blue + Green + Violet
rules: Whenever another friendly Geode Cracks, restore 1 HP to Aurex. KIMBERLITE — Mantle Detonation: the first Kimberlite discount each round is 2 instead of 1. FRACTURE — Fault Network: the first Fracture Prism each round also lets you draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Aurex as a colossal four-color worldheart sovereign, ancient living mountain-crystal with red, blue, green and violet cores in balanced symmetry.

name: Prismatic Search
rules: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put a Prism among them into your hand; put the rest on the bottom in any order.
art_target: Prismatic search phenomenon: four suspended cards/shards revealed through a crystal lens while one Prism is isolated by focused rainbow refraction.

name: Refract
rules: Choose a Prism attached to a friendly Dormant Geode. Switch it to its other printed color. Re-check that Geode's Crack Recipe.
art_target: A focused refracting beam rotating an attached Prism from one printed color to its other mode on a dormant geode.

name: Crystal Relay
rules: Choose a friendly Dormant Geode. Restore 2 HP to it. The next Prism attached to it this round contributes both of its printed colors toward its Crack Recipe.
art_target: Crystal relay arc linking a caster crystal to a wounded dormant geode, healing it while the next Prism path visibly doubles.

name: Perfect Alignment
rules: When you attach a Prism that leaves a Dormant Geode exactly one color short of Cracking, draw 1 card. The next Prism you play this round costs 1 less, minimum 1.
art_target: Perfect geometric alignment of multiple crystal rays leaving exactly one missing facet, with a final discounted Prism path opening.
